name: raindigit-360-tour-studio
description: Local RainDigit studio for preparing self-hosted 360 property tours.

scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run build:editor-ui && node --check scripts/tour-editor-server.mjs && node --check scripts/build-tour-release.mjs && node --check web-tour/js/tour-bootstrap.js && node --check web-tour/js/tour.js && node --check web-tour/js/tour-editor.js && node --check web-tour/js/tour-preview.js
scripts.build:release: node scripts/build-tour-release.mjs --workspace studio-workspace --output release --zip dist/raindigit-360-tour.zip --single dist/raindigit-360-tour.html --embed dist/raindigit-360-tour-embed.html --replace
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm run test:product && npm run test:studio-ui && npm run test:distribution && npm run test:release-browser
